body:
Hey all!

I've been working on modifying Film Scan Converter to make an integration into ART possible as I'm trying to consolidate my workflow a bit. I've got a fork of FSC [up here](https://github.com/Megabound/Film-Scan-Converter) with the added CLI arguments and ART User Commands as well as a short video on the install and use [over here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8uGc7bAjnsI).

Hope someone finds this useful!
title: Film Scan Converter Integration
